title: Migration and guidance: hosted agents start runs through the tool; CLI detach/notify stays for external coordinators; /review-changes uses host runs
outcome:
HOW
- src/coordination_instructions.rs (shared guidance text; tm-43f4 adds the wait rule): add 'Test runs: termal_start_test_run, then end your turn; the completion resumes you. Never poll or sleep.' in the same single text so all agents receive one teaching (tm-uvsv).
- delegation_mcp.rs tool description for termal_send_to_session (currently 'FIRE-AND-FORGET - there is no reply to await'): reword per tm-43f4.
- docs/test.md: hosted agents use the tool; `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify SESSION` remains for coordinators outside TermAl; summary/notify unchanged.
- .claude/commands/review-changes.md: Step 2 becomes 'start a host run (preset full) and end the turn; on resume read the bounded summary; on failure apply the gate-failure protocol'; Step 3/4 (two reviewers) after the resume; keep the no-nesting rule.

DEPENDS ON: tm-ncc6.4, .5, tm-43f4.

REVIEW FIXES (F19): the termal_send_to_session rewording belongs to tm-43f4 slice 1 - removed from this task. DEPENDS ON tm-uvsv (shared guidance seam for non-Codex roots) in addition to tm-ncc6.4, .5 and tm-43f4.
acceptance:
- A test pins that the shared guidance contains the test-run rule exactly once and that every hosted root agent receives it (tm-uvsv seam).
- review-changes.md describes the host-run flow (start, end turn, resume with summary, gate-failure protocol, then the two reviewers); a test or grep asserts no sleep/poll instruction remains in the command file.
- docs/test.md documents both paths (tool inside TermAl, CLI outside) without contradiction; wake body unchanged (tm-2jql).
